solver._status: DRAFT CANDIDATE, compared against solver_primary.json by scripts/calibrate_ode_classifier.py; not frozen, not run

_rationale.rtol_atol: 100x tighter than solver_primary.json, so that a converged fixed point sits well below the classifier's fixed-point bounds instead of at them
_rationale.t_max_t_tail: doubled from legacy with the tail kept at the final third, because lower Hill coefficients may settle more slowly; tail_range and final_derivative will show whether this suffices
_rationale.attempts: RK45 first; a larger RK45 budget only if the first hit its cap; an implicit stiff method only after a failure of any kind (2026-09-21 code review). Radau versus BDF to be chosen by benchmark before the freeze.

classifier._status: DRAFT, proposed for the registration, not frozen, not run

_rationale.fixed: tail range and final derivative thresholds from the 2026-09-21 code review; at rtol 1e-6 they sit at the solver's noise floor and reject converged fixed points, at rtol 1e-8 converged fixed points fall 10x inside them (results/audit/classifier_calibration*.json)
_rationale.oscillatory: tail range above 1e-4, inside [0, 1] up to the margin, and each half of the tail repeating the other's per-node maximum and minimum to within 5% of that node's range; nodes whose range is within the fixed-point bound count as static and are not compared
_rationale.extension_horizons: 60 -> 120 -> 240 -> 480 -> 960, the tail kept at the final third of each horizon and sampled at constant density. 480 and 960 were added after calibration found damped oscillations near a Hopf point (arabidopsis_cellcycle, n_H = 2) that settle only by t ~ 400-800 (results/audit/classifier_calibration_rtol1e-8_arabidopsis_n2.json)
